questions.q: What Apex code is required to make Change Data Capture start publishing change events for an object?
options: A custom webservice method
A call to EventBus.publish() inside a trigger
None — once CDC is enabled on the object in Setup, Salesforce publishes change events automatically with no explicit publish call
A Queueable job scheduled every minute
questions.explain: Unlike custom platform events, CDC publishes automatically once enabled on an object in Setup — no Apex publish call is needed.

questions.q: What does the changedFields field on ChangeEventHeader contain for a CREATE event?
options: Only the record's Id field
The previous version of the record
Every field on the object, since all of them are new
It is empty, since changedFields is only populated for UPDATE operations
questions.explain: changedFields lists which fields actually changed in an UPDATE; it is empty for a CREATE event since the concept of "changed" fields doesn't apply to a brand-new record.

questions.q: What is the Pub/Sub API channel naming pattern for subscribing to Change Data Capture events on a custom object?
options: /data/<ObjectName>__ChangeEvent
/events/<ObjectName>Change
/services/data/<ObjectName>
/apexrest/<ObjectName>ChangeEvent
questions.explain: Custom object CDC channels follow the /data/<ObjectName>__ChangeEvent pattern, built from the object's own __c-style API name.

questions.q: How is a CDC trigger on AccountChangeEvent different from a normal after-update trigger on Account?
options: There is no real difference between the two
The CDC trigger runs fully asynchronously in its own separate transaction, with no ability to block or be blocked by the original save, unlike a synchronous after-update trigger
The CDC trigger can prevent the original Account save from committing
The CDC trigger only fires for DELETE operations
questions.explain: CDC decouples the subscriber entirely from the original save's transaction, making it suited to continuously streaming changes rather than validating or blocking a specific save.

questions.q: What is the purpose of the changeOrigin field on ChangeEventHeader?
options: It lists every subscriber currently listening to the channel
It records the exact timestamp of the change
It helps a subscribing app recognize changes it made itself, to avoid reprocessing its own writes and creating a feedback loop
It stores the Salesforce API version used to save the record
questions.explain: changeOrigin lets a subscriber distinguish changes it caused itself from changes made elsewhere, preventing it from endlessly reprocessing its own updates.
